facts.fact: 队伍穿出林缘，落在一片草地上，草地高踞于灰蓝色大海之上，夕阳正从西边落下。
facts.anchor: They broke beyond the boughs on to a field of grass above a great grey-blue sea

facts.fact: 他们走出森林的地方是 Widdin；入林前，海还是「几周路程之外的梦」。
facts.anchor: Widdin. They had come out in Widdin.

facts.fact: Tilde 伏在马背上，马腹侧滴着血；Ysel 也捂着髋部受伤。
facts.anchor: Tilde was bent over her horse, its flank dripping with red.

facts.fact: 祭司 Dagobert 抹着额上的血，指认 Tilde 是女巫、说是她把森林召来害众人。
facts.anchor: I knew she was a witch! She called the forest upon us all!

facts.fact: Liran 当众把穿林归给 Dagobert，说他压过了国王；Dagobert 随即闭嘴。
facts.anchor: ‘Dagobert led us into the wood,’ said Liran. ‘Dagobert overruled his king.’

facts.fact: Elise 判断：父亲早知可能出错，仍放 Conrin 与 Dagobert 领宫廷入林，为的是削弱 Dagobert。
facts.anchor: He had meant to weaken Dagobert, who coveted and nibbled at the edges of his power

facts.fact: Hein 断臂接骨后，Elise 盼父亲安慰小儿子，国王却转头望向北面那条海。
facts.anchor: hoping he would offer his youngest son a word of comfort

facts.fact: 从 Tilde 手腕取出的刺不是褐的也不是黑的，而是血下白如骨、约一指尖长。
facts.anchor: but white as bone beneath the blood, and as long as fingertip, as if Tilde had been bitten by a wolf.
